title: Standalone Slide tail runtime and NoteManager ExecuteFrame producer

initial_formula.long_frame: 1.0 when deltaTime is strictly greater than the threshold

adaptive_substeps.division: 0x3776248..0x3776254 divides both ExecuteFrame and deltaTime by the chosen update count before the per-note loop.
adaptive_substeps.conservation: Each substep sees initial ExecuteFrame / count, so the sum across all substeps equals the initial clamped ExecuteFrame.

terminal_after.identity: The final Slide endpoint is a NoteSlideAfter with afterNote == null, not merely a generic hold-release timestamp.
terminal_after.move_state: The endpoint uses the same signed progress, real-line, over-line, Transform snap and Stop transition as other After nodes, with existAfterNote=false.
terminal_after.ordinary_miss: A stopped terminal endpoint uses AfterThrough when elapsed seconds are strictly greater than 0.21666667; AfterForce is unavailable without a successor.
terminal_after.type_eight_miss: A stopped terminal endpoint whose root GameNoteType is 8 accumulates ExecuteFrame and emits AfterThroughFlick at frameCounter >= 7.
terminal_after.damage: The shared NoteSlide.onMiss does not apply the one-fifth division to a terminal After node, so tail Miss uses full configured damage.
terminal_after.release: After callback submission, the root tail resolution removes render state and the existing root-owned deactivate cascade releases the pooled After object.

prototype.execute_frame_helper: note_manager_execute_frame implements the clamped producer and explicit 1..4 substep division.
prototype.tail_state: SlideTailRuntimeState independently exposes lane, width, progress, projected position, scale, NoteState, GameNoteType, end gesture, frame counter and miss reason.
prototype.render_output: RenderState.slide_tails and snapshot.render.slide_tails expose the active terminal After node separately from intermediate nodes and mesh segments.
prototype.automatic_miss: _expire_slide_tail replaces the earlier generic sweetFrame+9 timeout for Slide tails and routes AfterThrough or AfterThroughFlick metadata through the shared tail result path.
prototype.non_slide_behavior: Long-note tail release and timeout behavior remains on the existing generic lifecycle.

confirmed: ExecuteFrame is produced directly by NoteManager.ExecUpdate rather than by Unity Time access inside NoteSlideAfter.
ExecuteFrame represents clamped 60 Hz frame progress, not raw seconds.
adaptive NoteManager substeps divide both time delta and ExecuteFrame consistently.
terminal type-8 Slide After timeout is frame-progress based while ordinary terminal timeout is score-time based.
the terminal After Miss path uses full damage rather than intermediate one-fifth damage
inference: The backend-neutral runtime's one update call corresponds to one unsplit NoteManager outer update; note_manager_execute_frame exposes substep division for backends that reproduce the adaptive loop.
unresolved: Terminal directional and multiple-Flick After subclasses still share the generic SlideTailRuntimeState visual fields; subtype-specific Sprite and side-note animation state remains separate.
